item.countryroads.surveyors_stake.tip1: Right-click a door or gate: a path to the nearest road.
item.countryroads.surveyors_stake.tip2: Place more stakes to choose the way.
item.countryroads.surveyors_stake.tip3: Sneak + right-click a stake: end the path there.
item.countryroads.surveyors_stake.tip4: Built paths cost nothing and can be taken up.
countryroads.hud.door_boxed: No way out of this door
countryroads.hud.door_boxed.hint: Open a gap, or stake outside
countryroads.config.title: Country Roads
countryroads.config.header.new_worlds: New worlds (each world keeps what it was created with)
countryroads.config.player_speed.tip: Speed bonus for players on a road. 20%% is about Speed I.
countryroads.config.mount_speed.tip: Speed bonus for horses, donkeys, mules and camels on a road.
countryroads.config.no_monsters.tip: Monsters do not spawn on the road surface. Caves under a road are not affected.
countryroads.config.maps.tip: Roads are drawn as light lines on maps.
countryroads.config.house_paths.tip: The Surveyor's Stake builds a path from your door to the nearest road.
countryroads.config.old_chunks.tip: Chunks generated before Country Roads was installed get their road when they load. Chunks you have lived in are never touched.
countryroads.config.streets.tip: Village streets get the same look as the roads. Off: vanilla streets (roads still join them).
countryroads.config.signposts.tip: Signposts with destinations and distances, and lamp posts near villages.
countryroads.config.camps.tip: Abandoned camps beside some long roads.
countryroads.config.props.tip: Milestones, lost carts, shrines, benches and hay carts. 0%%: none.
countryroads.config.wheat.tip: Wheat fields beside roads in plains. 0%%: none.
